summary: Adds read-only `address list` (UserAddresses) showing address ids with a masked label (first character of each word, ZIP prefix) and never the street; CartSignaledEta auto-fills addressId from the single saved address matching the ZIP (or the only one; several matches fail with a masked candidate list asking for --address-id) and subtotal from CartTotals.retailerTotal of the explicit --cart-id when given (unreadable total: require --subtotal); --subtotal is strictly validated (plain decimal, at most 2 places) and normalized to a SharedMoneyInput with a string amount.
reason: cart cartsignaledeta needed an addressId and a SharedMoneyInput subtotal the CLI could not supply.

shape_sources.UserAddresses: public rspack chunk 95722 (UserAddressManager/AddressSelection/queries.ts): operation query, no variables; response data.userAddresses[] {id, postalCode, streetAddress, viewSection}
shape_sources.CartSignaledEta: chunk 95722 store header: variables {cartId, subtotal:{amount: CartTotals.retailerTotal.amount, currencyCode}, shopId, addressId: userLocation.addressId, postalCode, pageType}; pageType is optional (live)

validated_outcome: Fake-value stub tests: masked label hides the street, auto pick by ZIP, several same-ZIP addresses refuse with a masked list and send nothing, explicit --cart-id drives CartTotals, malformed --subtotal is rejected before any request, explicit flags win. Live read-only: address list returned ids with masked labels; cart cartsignaledeta answered with an ETA string using the auto-filled addressId and subtotal. Addresses are never cached.
